summary: Implemented the programmatic sheen trigger and the split-control mount-streak suppression. Added a private useSheenTrigger hook (mount baseline plus alternating parity), an optional sheenTrigger: string | number on ZestCustomProps, sheen marker classes on the button/wrapper, a CSS ::before sweep layer with alternating keyframe names for genuine replay, a focus-suppression marker for trigger-only buttons, disabled/busy-safe band colours and reduced-motion coverage. Documented sheenTrigger in the focus-sheen guide and the API reference. Added R6-R9, A1 and A2 tests. Finished slice 2 (documentation) of revision 2. Added the programmatic streak (`sheenTrigger`) to documentation/features.md, documentation/examples.md, documentation/configuration.md, README.md and documentation/development.md, each with a working example and the rules that it works with or without `focusSheen`, on split/disabled/busy buttons, and that reduced motion disables both triggers with no override. Strengthened the reduced-motion wording in docs/features/zest-button-focus-sheen/guide.md and added three A3 documentation tests to __tests__/ZestButtonFocusSheen.test.tsx. The code, CSS, hook, api.md and guide parts from the earlier attempt were already present and verified unchanged. Ran the build and the full suite (371 tests, all passing).
